How we work

Confidence comes from knowing what's happening.

You are handing a valuable asset to people you may never meet in person. So we show you the process rather than ask you to take our word for it.

Documented property inspections

Scheduled visits are recorded with dated photographs, condition notes and a list of follow-up actions, so you see the state of the property rather than a summary of it.

Maintenance you approve before it starts

For non-emergency work you receive the issue description, the vendor's quotation and the expected cost, and the work proceeds only after your approval, as set out in your service terms.

Clear owner communication

Updates on inspections, tenants, maintenance requests and completed work arrive on the channel and schedule agreed in your plan, usually WhatsApp and email.

Accountable support on the ground

Vendors, property visits and follow-up tasks are coordinated in Chennai by people who are answerable to you for each item until it is closed.

The process

Property management, made clear.

Four steps from first message to ongoing updates. Nothing starts until the plan is agreed.

Tell us about your property

Share the property type, location, occupancy and what you need handled, through the form or WhatsApp.

Discuss your requirements

We call or message you to understand the property, your expectations, service needs and budget.

Agree on the management plan

You receive the proposed scope, fee, responsibilities, approval process and reporting frequency in writing before onboarding.

Stay informed

After onboarding, inspections, updates and reports follow the schedule in your plan.

Read how it works in more detail

For owners abroad and out of town

Your property is in India. You don't have to be.

Owners abroad and owners in other Indian cities share the same problems:

  • You cannot fly in every time a tap leaks or a tenant has a question.
  • You want to see the property's condition, not just hear that it is "fine".
  • You want to know what a repair will cost before anyone starts.
  • You need someone to coordinate tenants, vendors and the association.
  • You want one accountable point of contact, in your time zone's waking hours where possible.

All frequently asked questions

Can Flourrish manage my property if I live abroad?

Yes. Most of our owners are not in Chennai. Inspection reports, maintenance quotations and approvals move over WhatsApp and email, and property visits happen locally in Chennai. The frequency of visits and updates is set in your management plan.

How are maintenance costs approved?

For anything that is not an emergency, you receive the issue, the vendor's quotation and the expected cost first. Work starts only after you approve it. Emergency handling is defined in the agreement before onboarding.

How are inspections documented?

Each scheduled visit produces a dated report with photographs, observations and recommended actions, sent to you by the channel agreed in your plan.

What does a management plan cost?

Fees depend on the property, its occupancy, how often you want inspections and what you need coordinated. We prepare a written proposal after a short call, so you can see the scope and fee together before deciding.

Does the service start as soon as I enquire?

No. An enquiry starts a conversation. Management begins only after the scope, fee and reporting arrangement are agreed in writing.

No questions match that. Ask us directly on WhatsApp or through the contact page.

What happens after you send this

We read it, then contact you by your preferred method during business hours (9:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST, all days). The first conversation is about your property and what you need; a written proposal follows if it makes sense to continue.

We do not ask for ownership documents, ID or bank details at this stage.
